title: Google AI Overviews become more common in search
summary: Google's AI-generated search summaries now appear in 43% of US searches, nearly tripling from 15% a year ago according to Similarweb's 2026 Generative AI Landscape report. The AI Overviews feature displays AI-generated summaries within conventional search results, while AI Mode offers a conversational interface for complex queries and follow-up interactions.
problem_solved: Demonstrates the rapid mainstream adoption rate of AI-generated content in traditional search engine experiences.
why_valuable: Provides critical market intelligence data showing how quickly AI is being integrated into everyday search behavior, with adoption nearly tripling in one year.
